pages.title: Flying Ships to Space
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() An Aeronautics ship can reach Northstar worlds with a **Dimensional Drive** or **Stellar Navigator**, no rocket needed.
- Both are built with a Stellar Core.
- Propellers and burners need air, and the Moon and Mercury have none: plan thrusters.

Two bridge mods let an Aeronautics ship cross to Northstar worlds without a rocket: the Dimensional Drive and the Stellar Navigator. Dimensional Sable lets [#](7A3C9A)[Sable](entry://glossary/sub_level)[#]() ships change dimension at all.

pages.title: Dimensional Drive
pages.text: Place on a ship. Right-click it, put a Space Atlas in its slot and pick a planet, then press **Arm Drive** and fly up to the trigger altitude.

pages.title: Recipe here
pages.text: In this pack the Dimensional Drive costs a [#](2E5AAC)[Stellar Core](entry://stars/stellar_core)[#](), 4 Titanium Ingots and 4 [#](2E5AAC)[Precision Mechanisms](entry://create_basics/brass_and_assembly)[#](). Press R over it in [#](2E5AAC)[JEI](entry://start_here/tools)[#]() to check. It can reach the Moon, Mars, Venus, Mercury, Earth and Earth Orbit.

pages.title: Using it
pages.text:
The drive must sit on an Aeronautics ship.

- With no atlas in its slot it always goes to **Earth Orbit**.
- Mars, Venus and Mercury also need an **Interplanetary Navigator** on board.
- [#](2E5AAC)[Goggles](entry://create_basics/tools_wrench)[#]() show destination, speed, altitude and the altitude needed.

pages.title: Trigger altitude
pages.text:
The trigger height is fixed, not set in the menu. From Earth:
- Earth Orbit and Moon: 1750
- Mars: 2200
- Venus: 2600
- Mercury: 3000

From anywhere else it is 1750. Hold that height for about 5 seconds while the drive spools, and stay on a seat so you land with the ship.

pages.title: Getting that high
pages.text: Air pressure fades to nothing by the top of the world (Y 320), so balloons and propellers stop lifting there. [#](2E5AAC)[Thrusters](entry://flight/propulsion)[#]() keep full power in thin air: with its exhaust pointing down, one fuelled Thruster lifted a small test ship past Y 1750 in under 10 seconds. Bring enough fuel to hold the height while the drive spools.

pages.title: Climbing safely
pages.text:
Fixed thrusters at full power with nobody steering can tip a ship over and drop it. Steer them (vector thrusters, or trim each one's power) and climb steadily.\
\
Ride in a **closed cabin**: open decks freeze you above Y 192 (see [#](2E5AAC)[Temperature and Create](entry://survival/temperature_create)[#]()). A very fast climb can make a busy server throw riders off.

pages.title: Stellar Navigator
pages.text: From Northstar Aeronautics Compat. Brings an Aeronautics vessel to another planet. It can be turned off in [#](7A3C9A)[config](entry://glossary/config)[#]().
Needs a Stellar Core and a bucket of [#](2E5AAC)[Levitite Blend](entry://flight/balloons_and_lift)[#]().

pages.title: Gravity and air
pages.text:
Ships that arrive take on the world's gravity and air. The Moon and Mercury have no air, Mars has almost none, and Venus is crushingly dense.\
\
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Watch out:** propellers and burners need air, so plan [#](2E5AAC)[thrusters](entry://flight/propulsion)[#](). See [#](2E5AAC)[Propellers](entry://flight/propellers)[#]().
